status: source_defined prospective Release 1.0 acceptance protocol; no evaluation results
cell_definition: 16 ordered perspective routes × Accumulation/Expenditure = 32; cells never multiply by faces twice
denominator_policy: Movement matrices use cells × types × settings. Family, nesting, population and negative panels use their actual declared unit, not invented cell-wide credit. Deterministic fixture frame is IEE; a social fixture includes one second different-type participant with fixed declared membership. Existing canonical evidence must be reconstructed, not inferred from a historical pass count.
workflow_domain_bounds_verbatim: The workflow domain has at most eight tasks, eight inputs, two participants, unit-duration serial scheduling and local slots 0–1,000.

requirements.title: Complete matrix
requirements.panel: Native canonical and workflow movements, paid outputs and actual downstream consumers

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Defining-step withholding, fixed downstream question and matched main spending; see 9.4
requirements.pass_condition: Every case has validated inputs, actual committed semantic output and paid work; every cell in each setting has an actual downstream consumer, exact before/after revisions and intermediate handoffs. No missing cell passes.

requirements.title: All type frames
requirements.panel: All 16 sealed Model A frames, separately in both settings

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Missing-capacity fixtures must not succeed because of a type label
requirements.pass_condition: All combinations audit; fixtures establish necessary abilities; budgets and incompletion disclosed; no competence manufactured by labels.

requirements.title: Distinct content settings
requirements.panel: Canonical condition/repair, scalar commitments/static interfaces versus timed maintenance runbooks, reciprocal commitments, teaching and custody handover

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Same renamed labels or altered quantities/types alone cannot establish a new setting
requirements.pass_condition: For all 32 rows independent reconstruction establishes applicable semantics in both settings and a concrete content/constraint difference. Canonical and scripted workflow coverage does not credit workflow selection, Shell or population.

requirements.title: Causal responsibility
requirements.panel: One fixed-query matched defining-step ablation per cell per setting on IEE; route-label metamorphic comparisons

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Remove the defining transformation or material command at equal main movement cost; downstream spending separate. Vary display route labels without altering contract identity.
requirements.pass_condition: All 64 ablations change the fixed downstream result and fail the ordinary semantic auditor. Display relabeling preserves outcomes. Immutable contract identifiers are not rewritten.

requirements.title: Compositional use
requirements.panel: Five connected families in each setting: Theorize→Apply→Embody; Share→Commune→Identify; Coordinate→Mobilize; Institutionalize→Educate; Organize→Integrate→Apply

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Remove one generated intermediate per family at matched main cost; retain inherited conflict on return
requirements.pass_condition: Each step consumes the exact preceding result with schema, scope, completion and authority checked; mixed polarities retained; inherited history/conflict/residue survives; all ordinary worlds audit and ablations change the end result and are rejected.

requirements.title: Both polarity faces
requirements.panel: Matched starts for the 16 routes in each setting

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Matched accumulation/expenditure starts; explicit convergence allowed when responsibilities legitimately yield the same answer
requirements.pass_condition: All 32 comparisons reconstruct responsibility differences in content, interaction, commitment or usable output, or explicitly establish legitimate convergence without inventing a difference.

requirements.title: Access and authority
requirements.panel: Inherited access regressions plus workflow negative controls on applicable shared/authorized cases

denominator.applicability: Each applicable cell also references its own paid access and authority evidence in the 32-row ledger.

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Independently remove paid reading, scope, assent or consent; never count an imagined agreement as actual uptake
requirements.pass_condition: Every negative case refuses the unsupported completed knowledge/action; all ordinary claims name exact receipts, ownership, scope and authority; assent, understanding and acquired skill remain distinct.

requirements.title: Partial and failed work
requirements.panel: Continuation at one paid unit, first semantic threshold, ready-before-commit; negative cancellation, exhaustion and stale-dependency cases in both settings

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Cancel/exhaust or change a live dependency; compare restored and uninterrupted runs from the same checkpoint
requirements.pass_condition: Continuation preserves identities, paid progression and effects exactly; spent work, prior intermediates and consumed one-attempt allowances are not refunded; staleness invalidates affected work without rewriting history.

requirements.title: Shell coverage
requirements.panel: Prevention and active interruption for every cell, each compared with undeformed control; all five effects and operationalized signs; correction and recurrence panels

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Matched undeformed comparison followed by paid correction and native consumer; active interruption retains first paid intermediate. Unsupported clearance must be refused.
requirements.pass_condition: All pairs reconstruct effect and opportunity, every supported kind and operationalized sign is evidenced, correction/recurrence/clearance controls pass. Generated approval is distinguished from fixture effects. Resource shortage, missing information, valid refusal and real danger remain separate explanations.

requirements.title: Situated autonomy
requirements.panel: Canonical and workflow automatic matrices, separate from scripted panels; canonical IEE matched choice controls; workflow IEE controls across 8+12+12 cells

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Choice withheld with comparison cost preserved and no native child, rejected by ordinary choice audit. Matched unresponsive controls for delivered relevant information, acquired practiced capacity on held-out target, and hidden not-delivered change.
requirements.pass_condition: All automatic cases audit from committed input/access/candidate/comparison/admission/native-child records; every cell has later paid consumption; all withholding controls rejected; responsiveness witnesses satisfy the three stated behaviors. No route, face, recipe, intended cell or evaluator answer in request; hidden state does not select.

requirements.title: Nested accountability
requirements.panel: Bounded parent with ordinary child, failed child, membership change and withdrawn participation in each setting

seeds.mode: deterministic exhaustive or fixed fixture; no random seed

requirements.control: Failure/membership/withdrawal variants of ordinary nesting; fabricated parent success must fail audit
requirements.pass_condition: Parent reconstructed solely from present compatible authorized children; failure visible, charges exactly once, no competence or knowledge from summaries; no general cross-owner nesting claim.

requirements.title: Regression and efficiency
requirements.panel: All inherited and new tests, panels, raw auditors, kernel probes and isolated measurement protocols

seeds.others: fixed deterministic fixtures and inherited seed declarations, retained unchanged

requirements.control: Unchanged direct native API versus preserved C5 on same platform/workload; matched active work across inactive history. Old checkpoints restore with their own engine.
requirements.pass_condition: 625 inherited methods and every new method pass, every executed file matches freeze; all population worlds reconstruct; unchanged-native median ratio ≤2/1 and fixed-active inactive-history median ratio ≤3/1; costs and actual coverage reported, failed attempts retained. Probes 10/10 and 17/17 on unchanged R21B; pyref rerun owed if absent.

population.initial_demands: supplied independently owned demands; no replenishment, new goals or growing population
population.coverage: Record actual route-face counts for every world; repeated outputs stay repeats; no full-cell sustained-development claim absent actual coverage. Exact midrun restoration required.

costs.native_protocol: tools/measure_c6.py and C6_Protocol_v1.json unchanged (3 timing samples)
costs.execution: Isolated workers on same interpreter/hardware, warmups and cache conditions matched; timing and tracing separate; retain each raw sample; no tuning tolerances after measurement. Freeze phase-specific executable workload protocol before implementation/evaluation.
costs.scaling: Vary participants, alternatives, composition depth and dependencies separately within declared bounds; inherit canonical budgets; workflow maximum two participants and eight tasks/inputs. Report deferred work.
costs.optimization: No gain claimed. Efficiency_Acceptance_v1.json remains unchanged and no new closure of its optimization targets is implied.

read_only_structure.phase_1_protocol: This section is the Phase 1 protocol before either new module is written.

tests: only source spine A6→A1→A8; internal-plane direction left open

read_only_structure.invariance: New modules are read-only. No grade/sign/subtype in execution, pricing or selection; no inherited source edits; baseline sealed; all 625 inherited methods must pass per batch. Table carries transcribed_not_reread=true.

evidence_and_audit.freeze: Before each evaluation, record every executed source/tool/test, relevant contract and kernel hash. Source changes invalidate the overlapping run, which remains preserved. Release freeze v5 covers every source, contract and tool.
evidence_and_audit.raw: Worlds, events, access receipts, checkpoints and every failed/source-changed attempt retained with SHA-256; large archives use the durable exact identity/index procedure in docs/Continuous_Build.md.
evidence_and_audit.independence: Auditors cannot import selector, executor or scheduler they audit. Planned auditor names are obligations, not claims of implemented tools. Ledger verifier reads saved worlds independently of builder output.
evidence_and_audit.ledger: 32 rows × 2 settings, each applicable section references saved raw evidence and hash. Non-applicability requires reason; never silently counted as pass. full_release_complete only when all applicable items in both settings pass.
evidence_and_audit.manifest: Append only this new protocol entry to Contract_Manifest.json as explicitly requested by batch 0.2. Preserve every inherited entry and all referenced bytes; archive its prior bytes in Git history. This bookkeeping update is not a changed inherited semantic contract.
